name: Schaeffler
verdict: Predominantly owned by the Schaeffler family. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Official Supplier of Jaguar TCS Racing from a multi-year agreement announced 19 March 2026 (Schaeffler press release; listed in the club's partners page for Season 12). The Schaeffler Group's own website describes it as predominantly in family ownership (Maria-Elisabeth Schaeffler-Thumann and Georg F. W. Schaeffler). No state stake and no human-rights finding against Schaeffler identified.
